name: orphans
description: Finds the processes Claude left running, asks the session whether it still needs them, and ends them when the session ends

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the status line, the command and the question the model reads (en uses /orphans, es uses /huerfanos)

askSession.title: Ask the session
askSession.description: After a command leaves a process running, ask the model once whether it still needs it

killAtSessionEnd.title: End processes when the session ends
killAtSessionEnd.description: Send SIGTERM to every process this session left running when it closes

scanIntervalSeconds.title: Scan interval (seconds)
scanIntervalSeconds.description: How often to look for forgotten processes while some are known (10-600)
